title: How To Assign Different Member Forms To Various Membership Plans | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
content: How To Assign Different Member Forms To Various Membership Plans Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000006663 It is possible to assign different forms to specific membership plans. For example, this allows to assign different contact details forms for a business listing and a different contact details form for general website users or individuals. Step 1 - Identify the Member Dashboard Form and Customize it For detailed instructions, see the following article: How To Customize Member Dashboard Forms Step 2 - Assign the Customized Form to a Specific Membership Plan Now that the custom form has been created, it can be assigned to the desired membership plan. To accomplish this, navigate to Finance >> Membership Plans >> Click " Edit " for the desired membership plan: Under Member Dashboard tab, select the customized form from the appropriate dropdown: Important Note: The word 'Listing' must be included in the form name for it to appear in the dropdown options above. For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard . Was this article helpful and accurate?
